definition: אַחְלָ֑מָה noun feminine perhaps amethyst (etymology dubious; below חלם Thes q. v.; Hal JAs 7, x. 426 from חלם être fort, solide ; Di Kn compare Talmud חַלְמִית , malva & think of green malachite; Dl HA 36 N derived from Aramaic land A—lamû ), amethyst according to ᵐ5 ᵑ9 Josephus; see also Lag GGA 1884, 285 , but compare Di ; one of the gems on the ephod Exod 28:19 ; Exod 39:12 .
